description:
Export a transcription as a ready-to-save markdown or plain text file.

STRONGLY PREFER passing 'output_path' — the server writes the file directly to disk, returning only a short confirmation message. This avoids loading the entire transcript into your context (massive token savings, especially for long meetings).

Without 'output_path', the full file content is returned in the response.

output_path.description: Absolute file path to save the export. When provided, the server writes the file and returns only a confirmation (no content in response — saves tokens).

name: memo_export_transcription
